subject: Discrete Mathematics: Set Theory & Algebra
name: Group Theory
priorityEvidence: 33 PYQs extracted, tested 1988-2024, very consistent recency (2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024 all have at least one PYQ). Last topic in the Foundations track since it needs Set/Relation/Function vocabulary already in place.

prerequisites.why: A group is a SET with a binary operation — needs set-notation comfort.
Cosets and conjugacy-style relations reuse equivalence-relation reasoning.

unlocks.why: Lattices are algebraic structures in the same family, built on similar closure/identity reasoning.
